impact:
WHERE THE DEFECT IS
- apps/web/src/screens/start/FuelPanel.tsx:270-277 — the `.fr-del` ✕ calls `remove.mutate(entry.id)` on the first tap, with no arming step.
- apps/web/src/styles/theme.css `.fr-del` — 15px glyph with 4px padding, roughly a 23px target, sitting beside the new 44px `.fr-open` edit target (T-046). A miss aimed at "edit" lands on "delete".

WHERE IT IS TRIGGERED FROM
"Logged today" on the Start screen (FuelPanel.tsx:238 onward).

THE WORKING COUNTER-EXAMPLE
T-003 fixed exactly this for logged sets: `components/RemoveSetButton.tsx` over `lib/use-armed-confirm.ts`, 44px box with negative margins, disabled while pending.

VERIFIED vs SUSPECTED
Verified by reading at HEAD (5abaf65); line numbers re-checked after filing. The 44px edit target was measured in Chromium during T-046. The mis-tap risk is inferred from adjacency, not reproduced. Now that an entry can be corrected, deleting is rarely the right tap, which raises the cost of a mistaken one.
resolution: Resolved by T-053. The one-tap ✕ is gone: tapping a logged entry now opens its actions, and Remove is a 44px armed two-tap confirm (useArmedConfirm), disabled while the delete is pending. See apps/web/src/screens/fuel/FuelLog.tsx.
title: Removing a fuel entry is one unconfirmed tap on a ~23px ✕
